map.计算单船锚泊旋回半径、所需锚泊面积与锚地可容纳船舶数量: Computes the swinging radius of a single vessel at anchor, the anchoring area required and the number of vessels an anchorage can hold
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：π × swingRadius × swingRad: Core formula (by input variables): π × swingRadius × swingRadius; anchorageKm2 × 1000000
map.📖 查看「锚地容量设计 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to anchorage capacity design
map.锚地规划或港口扩容评估时，用本工具按船长、水深、出链倍数与安全余量推算单船旋回半: When planning an anchorage or assessing a port expansion, use this tool to derive the swinging radius and footprint of a single vessel from ship length, water depth, cable scope factor and safety margin, and to estimate how many vessels the anchorage can hold.
map.开阔水域与遮蔽水域选择出链倍数（通常 4–7 倍水深），评估大风/强流下的安全余: Choose the cable scope factor for open or sheltered waters (usually 4 to 7 times the depth), and assess whether the safety margin is sufficient in strong wind or current and whether dragging is likely.
map.圆形旋回锚泊与方格固定泊位两种布局对比：前者各船独立旋回互不干扰但占地大，后者布: Comparing the two layouts, circular swinging anchorage and square fixed berths: the former lets every vessel swing independently without interference but takes more space, while the latter packs berths tightly but requires strict control so no swinging radius crosses a boundary.
map.锚地可容船舶数示例: Example: number of vessels an anchorage can hold
map.某锚地 10 km²、船长 200 m、水深 20 m、出链 5 倍、安全余量: An anchorage of 10 km², ship length 200 m, depth 20 m, cable scope 5 times, safety margin 50 m and a circular layout. Cable length = 20 × 5 = 100 m; swinging radius = 100 + 200 + 50 = 350 m; area per vessel = π × 350² ≈ 384,845 m²; vessels held = ⌊10 × 10⁶ ÷ 384,845⌋ = 25. With a square layout instead (berth spacing 2 × 350 = 700 m), the area per vessel is 700² = 490,000 m², holding ⌊10 × 10⁶ ÷ 490,000⌋ = 20 — the circular layout saves space, but anchor chains must be kept from tangling.
map.出链倍数取多少合适？: What cable scope factor is appropriate?
map.遮蔽水域可低至 3–4 倍水深，开阔或大风水域建议 ≥6 倍（本工具判定 >7: Sheltered waters can go as low as 3 to 4 times the depth, while open or windy waters suggest at least 6 times (this tool treats more than 7 times as suited to severe conditions). Too short a scope gives an insufficient swinging radius and the vessel drags in strong wind; too long takes more room and increases chain wear.
map.圆形和方格布局怎么选？: How do you choose between the circular and square layouts?
map.圆形旋回锚泊各船以锚为中心独立旋回、互不干扰，单船占地 πR²（R 为旋回半径）: In a circular swinging anchorage each vessel swings independently around its own anchor without interfering with others, occupying πR² per vessel (R being the swinging radius); square fixed berths pack vessels tightly (spacing 2R) but require that no vessel’s swing crosses its boundary, suiting well-ordered fixed-berth anchorages.
